name: test_delivery_freshness_rejects_naive_timestamps[sent_at1-sent_after1]
description:
Objective: Delivery freshness rejects naive timestamps — data partition: sent_after='datetime.datetime(2026, 8, 14, 10, 0)', sent_at='datetime.datetime(2026, 8, 14, 10, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)'.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import the production-support rule or page-object contract exercised by tests/unit/notifications/test_notification_portal_page.py.
3. Apply the exact parameter partition recorded in Test Data: {"sent_after": "datetime.datetime(2026, 8, 14, 10, 0)", "sent_at": "datetime.datetime(2026, 8, 14, 10, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)"}
4. Execute `test_delivery_freshness_rejects_naive_timestamps` exactly as defined in tests/unit/notifications/test_notification_portal_page.py:120.
5. Evaluate the deterministic assertion(s): `pytest.raises(ValueError, match='timezone-aware')`.
6. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: Delivery freshness rejects naive timestamps.
2. The outcome applies specifically to the recorded partition: {"sent_after": "datetime.datetime(2026, 8, 14, 10, 0)", "sent_at": "datetime.datetime(2026, 8, 14, 10, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)"}
3. The authoritative deterministic expression(s) evaluate as encoded: `pytest.raises(ValueError, match='timezone-aware')`.
4. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
